footer.tagline: Open legal workspace for work that matters.

hero.subtitle: One legal workspace for matters, documents, research, and agents.
hero.subtitle2: Grounded in sources, governed by your permissions, and built without lock-in.

home.ctaTitle: Your matters. Your stack. Your terms.

meta.homeDescription: Open source legal workspace for documents, matters, review, and research. Self-host or use our cloud. Usage-based AI, no lock-in.

story.agentBody: The agent searches the matter, reads the relevant text, and returns linked evidence. Use it in stella, Microsoft Teams, or through MCP and the CLI; the same permissions and sources follow the request.
story.agentTitle: Ask once. Work across every document.
story.dataBody: Search official legal sources, bring registry data into the matter, review document sets as structured tables, and anonymize identifying details before sensitive material enters an AI workflow.
story.dataInsetAlt: A due diligence extract with identifying details redacted in stella
story.dataMainAlt: An official Slovak court decision open in stella
story.dataTitle: Bring the law and the data with you.
story.deploySubtitle: Start in the cloud or deploy the same open-source workspace on your infrastructure.
story.deployTitle: Run it with us. Or run it yourself.
story.intro: A matter moves through the same connected system: from source material, through review and drafting, to a grounded answer or action.
story.proofByokBody: Use your own provider keys for AI features.
story.proofOpenSourceBody: Inspect the code and keep a portable system.
story.proofPermissionsBody: Requests remain scoped to the user and workspace.
story.proofSelfHostBody: Run stella on infrastructure you control.
story.title: One matter. Every part of the work.
story.workspaceBody: Documents, deadlines, structured review, and drafting stay together. Open a matter, see the work in context, and move from a table to the underlying document without rebuilding the trail.
story.workspaceTitle: The matter is the system of record.
